name: ai-tom-and-jerry
description: Asset pipeline entry points. The app itself is plain HTML and JS with no build step and no dependencies — npm is here only so the pipelines have a conventional name.

scripts.build:sprites: npm run build:cat-walk && npm run build:mouse-walk && npm run build:trapped
scripts.build:trapped: python3 tools/build_strip_sprites.py --character cat --animation trapped && python3 tools/build_strip_sprites.py --character mouse --animation trapped
